text: Transform into a fierce Boarrier Knight

Summons Elite: Boarrier Tyrant for a <style="accent-gn">3s</style> charge with extended tusks. Deals <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and knocks enemies airborne during the charge. Boarrier tusks tear through flesh, inflicting <style="accent-gn">100%</style> <linktext=3004><style="ItemQuality_5">Wound</style></linktext> on enemies hit for <style="accent-gn">15s</style>.

Consumes 45 Photon Energy to call down a blast of holy light on the target area, dealing Attack DMG and healing yourself based on HP lost (minimum heal: 5% of Max HP).

Tips: Cast when your HP is low—but not critically low—to maximize healing while staying safe.

Basic Attack: Scorching Swing
Executes a sequence of up to four attacks, dealing Attack DMG and recovering 3 Flame Soul.

Tips: Fill the gaps with Basic Attacks when Flame Soul is too low for other offensive skills.

Wields the weapon like a whirlwind, dealing Attack DMG to targets within 3 meters. Each spin consumes 260 Stamina. Tap again while skill is active to end it.

Strategy: Stamina must be reasonably allocated between damage output and survivability. When safe, it can be used more for dealing damage and increasing Formless level.

Double lightning-fast Iai Slashes. Inflicts Attack DMG on enemies at the cost of 50 Blade Intent. Once Attack Speed reaches 25%|50%|90%, deals 1|2|3 additional attack(s). If Blade Intent remains after the strike, the skill can be recast.

Tips: Core skill of the Spec. Consumes Blade Intent to deal DMG. Release when Blade Intent is at its maximum.

Consumes 40 Rage to gather Strength and dash forward, knocking back all enemies in the way and dealing continuous Attack DMG. When the dash ends, unleashes a devastating slam that causes massive Attack DMG. The dash can be redirected. Targets with Resilience won't be knocked back but will have it reduced.

Tips: Cast against enemies without Super Armor or chip away at tough targets' resistance.

Basic Attack: Halberd's Edge
A heavy four-strike combo with a wide-blade weapon, each strike dealing Attack DMG and generating Rage
Plunge Attack: Assault
Raise your blade high and dive from the air, slashing through enemies along your descent. Upon impact with the ground, deals Attack DMG.

Continuously draws bow to launch a barrage of arrows at enemies, dealing Attack DMG. Recast to end early.
While in Photon Reforge state, Photon Energy consumption stops until the next Special Attack cast and hitting enemies recovers up to 42 Photon Energy.

Tips: Cast during Photon Reforge state to pause Photon Energy consumption and regenerate Photon Energy.

Enters Focus state, greatly increasing Haste and reducing the CD of Special Attacks by 50%.

Tips: Best paired with Falconry Spec. Use it just before activating Photon Reforge for maximum uptime.

A mobile performance melody. While performing, continuously heals allies. Deals Magic DMG to nearby enemies. Each healed ally increases healing by 6%, up to 30%. Each enemy hit increases DMG by 6%, up to 30%.

Tips: Sustained healing and DMG. Adjust your position based on the number and location of targets to maximize efficiency.

Gains unwavering resolve and throws 5 shields at the enemies within 10m (closest first), dealing Attack DMG and interrupting them. Afterward, throws 1 time every 2s and gains 10 Photon Energy each time. For the next 10s, each instance of damage taken is reduced by a percentage of the caster's Max HP, and the caster automatically counters Lethal Skill.

Tips: This skill requires no Photon Energy or Holy Sigil to cast and provides solid survivability, making it suitable as an opener.

Resonates with Olvera's soul power, dashes back and forth, gathering enemies along the path and dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>. Has a chance to apply Seed of Lightning to targets when dealing DMG, lasting for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>. Dealing DMG to targets with Seed of Lightning will cause it to explode (CD <style="accent-gn">2s</style>), dealing <style="magic">Magic DMG</style>, shared by surrounding enemies. Any defeated target with Seed of Lightning will reduce the CD by <style="accent-gn">15s</style>.

Resonance Tower's soul power, the team will not be defeated for a certain period of time, and health will not fall below a certain proportion.
[Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 100s]

Releases an energy wave, interrupting all targets within 10m and taunting them. Greatly increases Aggro against affected targets for 10s.

This skill is unaffected by CD effects.

Slam the ground 5 meters in front of you, creating a powerful tremor that stuns all enemieswithin range. If the enemy has Super Armor, this will instead deal significant Super Armor damage.
If you successfully evade Lethal Skill, CD will be reset immediately.

Summon a gravitational singularity, continuously drawing in nearby enemies. Units affected by the singularity are subjected to periodic DMG and become stunned.
If the enemy possesses Super Armor, it will instead deal high Super Armor DMG.
Raises a Block Shield for 2s. The Block Shield will block the next incoming hit. Successful Block reduces the CD of all your Weapon skills.

<style="accent-gn">Transforms into</style> Boss: Inferno Ogre to unleash a forward fiery breath that deals <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupts</style></linktext> affected targets. Concurrently, applies <style="accent-gn">Healing</style> to you, and <style="accent-gn">100%</style> excess healing is converted into a <style="accent-gn">Shield</style> lasting <style="accent-gn">20s</style>. The transformed form reduces DMG taken by <style="accent-gn">50%</style>.
[Elite Summon] - Void Foxen. Pounces forward with blinding speed, dealing AoE <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and increasing <style="accent-gn">Haste</style> for <style="accent-gn">20s</style>.

Summons Tatta to grant Battle Will to the entire team, preventing all allies from being defeated and ensuring their HP does not fall below a certain threshold for a period of time.
Exhausted: Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s (Exhausted effects are enhanced in party dungeons of Nightmare mode).

Resonates with the power of Elite: Crimson Sprayer to transform into its form. Deals <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> to nearby enemies and inflicts <style="accent-gn">100%</style> <linktext=3004><style="ItemQuality_5"> Wound</style></linktext> for <style="accent-gn">15s</style>.

Summons Elite: Great Warhog to release a Lightning Orb forward, dealing Attack DMG.
Upon the skill cast, your Light Bonus is increased for a period.

Summons Boss: Cabbage Kingpin to briefly charge up and slam the ground with a hammer, dealing Attack DMG.
After casting, your passive effect is locked to the displayed sigil for 20s, and its effect is increased by 100%-150%.

Summons Elite: Gloomy Cabbage to briefly charge up and swing a greatsword, dealing Attack DMG to targets in the area.
After casting, your Crit and Crit DMG are increased for a while (the values fluctuate based on the Cabbage sigil).
Launch into the air and fly forward.
Charges through the waves! Splashes water and dashes at high speed, leaving a dazzling "swimming trail!"
A bird takes flight, bearing a letter from the land of snow! Cast to fly forward at high speed.
Dashes forward a certain distance and gains increased Movement Speed.
Keep up with this alluring rhythm! After casting, quickly float and glide forward.
Explodes after a short countdown, freezing nearby players.
Upgrades weapons for <style="physical">15s</style> after use. Weapon attacks <style="physical">unleash a tornado</style> with a <style="physical">100% Range bonus and 50% Distance bonus</style>.

Vines sprout and flowers bloom beneath all Stalkers on the map.
The plants entangle the Stalkers for 3s.
"...so it is!"
